extension.summary: Widgets and lists from your self-hosted Floppy tracker
extension.description: Browse your Floppy (self-hosted media tracker) library from Kodi: Continue Watching, Next Up, Top Picks, Trending, watchlists, history, calendar and your own lists. Every category can be used as a skin widget. Items play through any player add-on you configure, and resume positions are saved back to Floppy.
extension.disclaimer: Requires a running Floppy instance and its API token (Settings, Integrations, API Token).
extension.news: 1.3.1: Background trailers played by skin.ultra are no longer tracked and don't take a pending play's details. 1.3.0: No longer needs TMDb Helper: play through any add-on with a plugin path (browse add-ons or pick a TMDb Helper-style player file) or a custom URL, with TMDb Helper placeholders and encodings. Playback started outside Floppy, such as from a skin, is tracked and resumed too. Search results carry full tracked state, anime included. Episode lists fill missing plots, runtimes and stills from TMDb. Skins get watchlist status and the show's IMDb id on episodes. Widgets refresh only when Floppy data changes, unless Refresh widgets automatically is on. Playback settings changed: choose your player again under Playback.

extension.description: Torrest is a service with a rest API which allows torrent streaming.
extension.news: - Update torrest binary to v0.0.8 - Add proper info to the play list item

extension.summary: Plays movies and episodes from Stremio and Nuvio add-ons.
extension.description: A player for Kodi: give it a title's ids and it asks your Stremio-protocol add-ons (Torrentio, AIOStreams, ...) for streams, then plays the best one or the one you pick. Use it from skin.ultra, Floppy, TMDb Helper or any add-on that takes a player path. Manage sources adds, configures, reorders and removes the add-ons.

extension.summary: Floppy, its TMDb Helper sync, Ultra Player and a Torrest fork.
extension.description: Installs and updates haywirephoenix's Kodi add-ons: Floppy, TMDbHelper Sync - Floppy, Ultra Player (plays titles from Stremio and Nuvio add-ons), and a Torrest fork with buffering status for skins.

Watched history, resume points, watchlist, dropped shows, next episodes, synced-state actions and scrobbling for TMDbHelper from a self-hosted Floppy tracker. Uses the address and API token from the Floppy add-on (plugin.video.floppy) unless set here.
extension.disclaimer: Requires a running Floppy instance and its API token (Floppy, Settings, Integrations, API Token).

extension.summary: Installs the Floppy sync provider for TMDbHelper.
extension.description: Installs TMDbHelper Sync - Floppy, which syncs watched history, resume points, watchlist, dropped shows and next episodes between TMDbHelper and a self-hosted Floppy tracker, and scrobbles to it. Open this add-on to set the sync up: your Floppy address and API token (or leave them to the Floppy add-on), then choose Floppy in TMDbHelper's settings.
extension.disclaimer: Requires a running Floppy instance and its API token (Floppy, Settings, Integrations, API Token).
